parameters.jsCode: const reply = String($json.output || ''); const normalized = reply.normalize('NFKC').replace(/[\u2010-\u2015\u2212\uFE63\uFF0D]/g, '-').replace(/\s/g, ' '); const checks = { hasReply: reply.length > 40, hasSymbol: /\bNVDA\b/i.test(normalized), hasExactPrice: /123[.,]45/.test(normalized), hasExactChange: /-1[.,]25\s*%/.test(normalized), explainsWatch: /WATCH/i.test(normalized), hasSafetyLanguage: /(not financial advice|educational|simulat)/i.test(normalized) }; const failed = Object.entries(checks).filter(([, ok]) => !ok).map(([name]) => name); if (failed.length) throw new Error('AI grounding smoke failed: ' + failed.join(', ') + '\nReply: ' + reply); return [{ json: { pass: true, checks, reply } }];
